name: Qube Browser 0.5.1
notes:
0.5.1
Fixed:
* Updates no longer fail right after you press Update

0.5.0
New:
* Notes: text notes and whiteboards, as tabs and in the Library
* Command bar with 60 commands, and Ask AI
* Qube Spark: chat with Claude or ChatGPT
* Streaming Space: a Space with a tile per streaming service
* Little Qube: links from other apps open in a small window
* Spotify as music source, next to Apple Music
* Per profile: search engine, download folder and extensions
* Full keyboard and Narrator support
* Settings in the Windows 11 style
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Improved:
* Tabs not used for an hour are unloaded to save memory
* Windows from your last session reopen at start

Fixed:
* Permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
summary: Notes, a new command bar, a Streaming Space, and support for PCs without a graphics card.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.10.9
mac.notes:
New:

* Notes: a table from the / menu; right-click adds or removes rows and columns, Tab goes to the next cell
* Notes: a toggle, a heading with a triangle that folds the blocks under it away
* Live Captures: Play on a Capture shows the real page in its place, usable as it is; Pause turns it back into the picture, ⌘R reloads it
* Edit › Copy URL as Markdown (⌥⇧⌘C), Find Next (⌘G) and Find Previous (⇧⌘G)
* File › Capture Full Page, View › View Source (⌥⌘U), Tabs › Close Split View and Separate Tab from Split, Qube › New Profile…
* Help › Keyboard Shortcuts (⌘/) lists every shortcut, with a search field
* A tab group made in the sidebar is seen by extensions as one of their tab groups

Changed:

* An Essential's notification dot sits in the tile's top-right corner; the Teams status dot moved to the icon's top-right corner

Fixed:

* Every Peek and Little Qube left a hidden window in the engine until Qube quit; they are now cleaned up
mac.summary: Notes get tables, toggles and live Captures, and the menu bar has more of Arc's items.
